These commands are available three ways — in the FREE-WILi GUI app, in a serial
terminal, and on the device itself. See
[Connecting it to a computer](../start-here/connecting.md) for how to reach them.

## Add

Adds an app signal.

**How to use it** — press `a`. At the prompt, enter: Signal name.

**What you enter** — `name`.

## Remove

Removes an app signal.

**How to use it** — press `x`. At the prompt, enter: Signal name.

**What you enter** — `name`.

## Rename

Renames an app signal.

**How to use it** — press `r`. At the prompt, enter: Old and new names.

**What you enter** — `name`, `new_name`.

## Set Value

Sets an app signal value.

**How to use it** — press `s`. At the prompt, enter: Signal name and value.

**What you enter** — `name`, `value`.

## Get Value

Gets an app signal value.

**How to use it** — press `g`. At the prompt, enter: Signal name.

**What you enter** — `name`.

## Apply Wave

Applies wave mode 0-8 (0 off; sine, triangle, square and saw at 0.5/2 Hz).

**How to use it** — press `w`. At the prompt, enter: Signal name and wave mode.

**What you enter** — `name`, `wave`.

## Stream

Streams every defined app signal; 0 disables streaming.

**How to use it** — press `t`. At the prompt, enter: Stream interval in milliseconds.

**What you enter** — `stream_rate_ms`.

**See also:** [App Data panel](../panels/app-data.md) — the on-screen panel for this.
